system.description:
¿Por qué no los dos?

—Mia Agraviador, Old El Paso Taco Commercial

Spellblades, gishes, arcane knights, and eldritch tricksters all. Magi are arcane specialists that blend magic and martial prowess.

Iconic Magi

  • Alucard, Castlevania
  • Elric of Melniboné, Stormbringer
  • Geralt of Rivia, The Witcher
  • Twilight Suzuka, Outlaw Star

Playing Magus

The magus may be a bit more challenging for newer players. Their playstyle is more build-dependent than the other classes, allowing for backline blasters, midline harassers, and frontline strikers.

Action: Attack/Cast
Move: Flexible
Starting Pack: Knight, Gladiator, or Warrior
Key Stat: Reason
Complexity: ★★★★☆
Training: Arcana, Melee

levelFeatures.name: Arcanum
levelFeatures.description:
You gain the Gish Perk (p. 69) and can Cast Spells using Arcana.

Spells: You learn 2 Spells, one of which must always have a damage base. You learn 1 other Spell every 3 Levels hereafter.

Mana: Your Max Mana is equal to (2 × your Level), and your Cast Max for Spells is equal to (1 + half your Level, round up).

levelFeatures.name: Enspell
levelFeatures.description: You can have one Imbue Casting as continual duration on your Weapon, and can skip your Move to change the Spell.

levelFeatures.name: Spell Parry (15+)
levelFeatures.description: If the result of your Save against a Cast Action exceeds your Difficulty by 15, you can choose a different Target for it, ignoring Immunity. The number needed to exceed is reduced by 1 every 4 Levels hereafter.

levelFeatures.name: Perk
levelFeatures.description: Choose a new Perk. You must meet the prerequisites to take it, unless the Perk is granted through a Class Feature.

levelFeatures.name: Arcane Surge (1 Mana)
levelFeatures.description:
It costs 1 less Mana to Cast your Imbued Spell with other Deliveries.

Further, once per Round when you deliver a Spell with an Imbued Weapon, you can do so against one Target with a 1 Mana discount. This discount increases every 4 Levels hereafter.

levelFeatures.name: Esoteric Flow
levelFeatures.description:
You can cause the damage of your attack to use the damage base of your Imbued Spell.

Further, you are permanently under the effects of the Blink Spell.
